LanguageData.EF_VPE_Weight_Desc: How likely the traits that grant Vanilla Psycasts Expanded psycasts are, next to other traits of the same rarity. 0 = they never roll. Items that already have them keep them.
LanguageData.EF_VPE_KeepVanilla_Tip: Chaos Skip, Far Skip and Stun Charge grant Royalty's own psycasts. While Vanilla Psycasts Expanded is active they stop rolling unless this is on. Items that already have them keep them.
